::: {.callout-note}
**Audience:** instructors / content authors.  
Source document: `Qualifikationskriterien_MfB_english 1.odt` (BridgeCourse folder).  
QuBi I **cannot** address every MfB outcome for years 1–2. Goal: **touch many** codes deliberately, deepen a few, leave the rest to parallel courses (esp. programming + stats).
:::

## MfB codes (reminder)

| Code | Area |
|---|---|
| **LOG** | Logic & critical thinking (assumptions, misleading viz, hypotheses, AI ethics) |
| **MATH** | Analysis & linear algebra (derivatives, ODEs, stability, matrices) |
| **PROB** | Probability (distributions, LLN/CLT intuition, simple stochastic processes) |
| **DAT** | Data science (process/visualize in R, structures, FAIR; ML/PCA lightly) |
| **PROG** | Programming (functions, loops, simulation, reproducible notebooks) |
| **STAT** | Statistics (descriptive; inferential mostly elsewhere) |
| **MOD** | Mathematical modelling (discrete/continuous; det/stoch; assumptions) |

---

## Where QuBi I touches each code

| Code | Strong touch in QuBi I | Lighter / foreshadow | Mostly elsewhere |
|---|---|---|---|
| **MOD** | W2–4 eco models; W5–7 selection; W8–10 establishment & rescue | Stability language around logistic / LV | Full phase-plane theory course |
| **PROG** | Every week: function → vector → loop; Quarto notebooks | Matrices for replicates (W9–10) | Python track; software engineering |
| **LOG** | Model assumptions; model vs data honesty; checkpoint talks; **AI policy** | Spotting bad viz in microbiome block | Formal fallacy curricula |
| **DAT** | W11–13 load/join/visualize complex tables | FAIR-ish habits (cite data, disclose) | Excel track; full ML/PCA course |
| **MATH** | Interpret \(dn/dt\), \(dp/dt\); discrete updates as Euler-ish steps | Equilibria intuition (logistic, selection) | Formal derivatives, eigenvalues, Leslie |
| **PROB** | Establishment as stochastic fate; rescue probabilities; replicate cultures | LLN vibe via many sims | Distribution theory, Markov homework |
| **STAT** | Qualitative pattern reading; means of replicates | p-values / CI only if needed for a dataset story | Dedicated stats course |

---

## Design rules for authors

1. Prefer **one clear MfB-aligned learning goal** per week over covering a whole code domain.
2. When you add math, keep it **interpretive** unless the parallel maths course already did the formalism.
3. Every checkpoint should force: assumption + figure + “what we are not claiming” (**LOG**).
4. AI policy covers MfB’s ethical AI outcome (**LOG** / **DAT** / **PROG**).
5. Do **not** promise PCA/ML, full ODE stability proofs, or inferential stats mastery in QuBi I.

---

## Gaps we accept (on purpose)

- Heavy **STAT** inferential pipeline  
- Full **MATH** eigenvalue / Leslie treatment  
- **DAT** machine learning beyond optional foreshadow  
- Gillespie SSA (named in MfB MOD examples) — optional stretch, not core  

If a collaborator wants to deepen one gap, prefer an **optional notebook appendix**, not a new required week.
